description: This file contains TypeScript code for interacting with Ollama models, including schemas for model data, functions to parse model info, and an async function to fetch available models from an Ollama server.

methods.name: parseOllamaModel
methods.description: Parses raw model data into a ModelInfo object if the model supports native tools.

methods.name: getOllamaModels
methods.description: Fetches and returns a record of model names to ModelInfo objects from an Ollama server.
